## What’s New in Tomati 2.1
Tomati 2.1 makes choosing a timer faster, simplifies Settings, and introduces secure in-app updates.
### New
- Added built-in update checks powered by Sparkle. - Added a native **Check for Updates…** button in About Tomati. - Added a dedicated **What’s New** section in Settings. - Grouped quick presets into a single compact menu. - Added clean default values for presets, accent color, alarm sound, and menu bar icon.
### Improvements
- Made the draggable minute scale denser, reducing the distance needed to select longer timers. - Simplified the Sessions editor and empty state. - Aligned System toggles consistently against the right margin. - Reorganized Settings into General, Sessions, System, Sounds, About, and What’s New. - Debug builds now start with clean defaults on every run, without affecting saved preferences in release builds.
### Defaults
- Presets: 5, 15, 25, and 50 minutes. - Sessions: empty. - Accent color: Tomati red. - Alarm sound: Ping. - Menu bar icon: Tomati.
